item.title: Ocean Mixing Barrier Shown: Dye experiment maps slow downward transport; layered structure limits exchange
item.description: In a recent experiment near Martha’s Vineyard, scientists introduced rhodamine dye into the Atlantic Ocean to study its behavior. Findings showed a marked difference in mixing rates, emphasizing the complexities of ocean stratification on substance movement. This research is vital for the advancement of nutrient and pollutant transport models. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
